questions.question: Is it gentle on hands?

questions.question: What's the shelf life?
questions.validationRule: FAIL if any duration is stated

questions.question: Can I use it in a dishwashing machine?

questions.question: What colour and fragrance does it have?
questions.validationRule: Exact match; note colour quantity is 'as required', not a fixed weight
